Anya: Quick PR opened — geo-matrix page has a bad EU endpoint link and the Python SDK snippet still uses `region=` param. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452
Sam: Ack, will take a look :eyes:
docs-bot: link-checker: 1 broken URL found in docs/geo-matrix.md -> https://old-eu.redwood.ai/endpoint
Marco: I can fix the link, but we should also clarify data residency vs processing region. The current wording says "data stored in region" which is ambiguous.
Lina: Also the SDK snippet shows `region='eu-west'` — our new SDK uses `endpoint='https://eu.api.redwood.ai'` + `residency='eu'`. Need to update example.
Sam: Suggest change: update the Python snippet from:
```
client = RedwoodClient(region='eu-west')
resp = client.generate(...)
```
to
```
client = RedwoodClient(endpoint='https://eu.api.redwood.ai', residency='eu')
resp = client.generate(...)
```
Anya: Perfect. Can we add a short footnote explaining that "residency" controls where customer data is persisted, while endpoint controls compute locality? Short sentence and link to residency page.
Marco: I'll push a commit to the PR with link fix + snippet + footnote. Will also add a test case for the sample link.
Lina: Ping me when ready; I'll review the wording for legal/marketing tone. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: PR #452 updated: 3 files changed, 1 link fixed, 1 snippet replaced
Anya: Thanks everyone — targetting merge after Lina's review. If anyone sees more region examples (JS, cURL), drop them here and I'll batch the changes.
Sam: I'll grep repo for `region='` and `region:` in JS snippets and paste results.
